name: actor_instance
description: Definition schema for actor/actuator instances with safety limits and help texts

instance_name.description: Unique identifier for this actuator instance

actor_type.description: Physical actuator classification (e.g. pwm_valve, stepper, relay)

safety_limit.description: Upper safe excursion bound (percentage or engineering unit)

pin_channel.description: Hardware control pin or output channel

help_text.description: Help text explaining safety restrictions, emergency shutdown, and actuation profile
help_text.default: Actuates the primary coolant delivery valve. In emergency loss-of-signal events, the valve defaults to 100% open.
